entries: From Middle High German bīzic, bīzec, *bizzic, from Old High German bizzīg, bīzīg, equivalent to Biss + -ig. Doublet of beißig. Cognate with Middle Low German bētich.

senses: strong/mixed nominative/accusative neuter singular of hammerhart

entries: From Middle High German honic, honec, hönic, hünic, from Old High German honag, from Proto-West Germanic *hunag, from Proto-Germanic *hunagą. Cognate with English honey.
From Ignatius by dropping the Latin ending.
senses: a male given name, equivalent to English Ignatius

entries: From Latin sub- + sūmptus, perfect participle of Latin sūmere (“to take”) with noun suffix -tion.
